raw.text: If the retro-reflector has essential metal components susceptible to corrosion, the saline mist shall be produced by atomizing, at 35 °C ± 2 °C, a solution of 5 parts by weight of sodium chloride in 95 parts of distilled water containing not more than 0.02 per cent impurities.

candidates.text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the retro-reflector.

raw.text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the retro-reflector.

candidates.text: After the corrosion test and a recovery period of 48 hours, the coefficient of retro-reflection RA of the retro-reflective areas shall be not less than the value in Table 9 and not more than the value in Table 10. It is measured as specified in Part 2 of Annex 6 at an entrance angle β2 = 5° and an observation angle α = 20', after the surface has been cleaned of salt deposits.

candidates.text: If the retro-reflector is mirror-backed with an accessible rear face (moulded plastics Class IA or IB), the rear face shall withstand the following sequence. It is brushed with a hard nylon brush. A cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture defined in Part 1 of Annex 7 is then applied to it for one minute and removed, and the device is left to dry. As soon as evaporation is completed, it is brushed again with the same brush.

candidates.text: If the retro-reflector is mirror-backed with an accessible rear face, its RI shall be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2 of this Regulation after the rear-face resistance test, with the whole surface of the mirror-backed rear face covered with Indian ink.

candidates.text: Resistance to fuels: when the outer surface of the retro-reflective device, in particular the illuminating surface, is lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a test mixture of 70 vol. per cent n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent toluol, the surface, inspected visually after about five minutes, must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.

candidates.text: Resistance to lubricating oils (moulded plastics reflectors of Class IA or IB): after the outer surface of the retro-reflective device, in particular the illuminating surface, has been lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil and cleaned after about 5 minutes, the retro-reflector's CIL (RI) shall be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation and shall meet the requirements of that paragraph.
